children: Choice Institutional Equities's report on Jupiter Life Line Hospitals

JLHL is positioned for a sustained growth, driven by faster ramp-up at Dombivli, improving utilisation across established hospitals and a gradual shift towards super specialities. Planned expansion across Pune South, Mira-Bhayandar and BKC provide additional capacity-led growth opportunities, while operating leverage and maturing case mix could support profitability improvement over the medium term. View and Valuation.

We expect Revenue/EBITDA/APAT to expand at a CAGR of 23.4%/23.1%/20.1% over FY26–29E. Valuing the stock on DCF (including the BKC expansion plan), we have revised our target price to INR 340 (from INR 410) and retain a ‘BUY’ rating on the stock. The revision in PAT is attributable to higher debt levels to fund the company’s expansion plans.
